hero.title: Master English Through Real Financial Commitment.
hero.description: Ethio-Lingo combines structured English online learning across 6 curriculum levels with a Financial Escrow Staking Engine. Lock your stake, complete 4 daily tasks, pass the 20-question exam, and protect your capital.

tasks.title: The 3 Daily Learning Tasks
tasks.description: Every day, learners complete the lesson video and listening practice, then pass the daily exam to advance their streak and protect their money.
tasks.task1Desc: Watch the daily educational YouTube lecture. Seeking is locked; video must be watched for 100% duration to mark completed. Includes downloadable PDF reference book.
tasks.task2Desc: Choose between Informative or Educational Entertainment YouTube videos based on learner preference. Seeking locked, 100% duration required.
tasks.task3Desc: Unlocks only after Task 1 and Task 2 are completed. Take a 20-question multiple-choice exam. Score ≥15/20 (75%) to pass and advance to the next module.

levels.title: 6 Levels of Comprehensive Curriculum
levels.description: Each level consists of 30 daily modules. Take the 10-question placement quiz to start in Beginner I or Intermediate I.

staking.title: How Staking & Protection Work
staking.description: Money locked in escrow enforces daily habit building. Pass daily tasks and exams to protect 100% of your staked capital.
staking.depositDesc: Deposit 1,000 ETB via Telebirr or Ethiopian Bank Transfer. With a 0% platform fee, your full 1,000 ETB is locked in your escrow vault.
staking.penaltyDesc: Failing an exam attempt slashes 25 ETB. Missing a 24-hour day window slashes 80 ETB, resets streak to 0, and forces module repeat.
staking.withdrawalDesc: Upon completing a 30-day level, submit bank / Telebirr details to request manual withdrawal approval, or continue to the next level if stake > 100 ETB.
staking.trialTitle: Want to try Ethio-Lingo before staking money?
staking.trialDesc: Try 3 free preview modules without financial stake or streak penalties. Upgrade anytime to the paid tier!
